note: Ordering over multibyte text, which already agrees: (t nil t t) on both sides. fe compares strings by byte and Emacs by character code, and for UTF-8 those two orders coincide -- which is a property of the encoding, not a coincidence, and is why this row is `supported` rather than lucky. Phase 25.1 rewrites `Equal`'s word-compare arm and this is one of the cases that must not move when it does.
